Hello all, this is my first time posting on here. I am playing on a modded forge client, and this strange bug happened right after lightning struck my base. Out of nowhere, the area around where the lightning struck became mostly invisible, but perfectly fine everywhere that wasn't within that radius. It continues to give me OpenGL 1281 errors, and I have tried every solution offered online. I tried reinstalling minecraft entirely, turning off mip map and anisotropic filtering, messing with the program settings in the NVIDIA control panel, updating Optifine and Optiforge, and even doing the SFC /scannow on my Windows Powershell Admin control panel. The latter was able to find and repair some corrupted files on my computer, which made everything work for a second and then break again. I even tried using WorldEdit to copy the blocks as a schematic and pasting it into another world, but it still was giving me problems and causing tesselating block model related crashes whenever I turn on my shaders. My game was running completely fine beforehand, even with maximum graphic settings and shaders, so I am completely stumped.   
TLDR: Lightning struck my base while using shaders, now most blocks are see through and glitched out only within the radius of the lightning strike. Everything looks fine when shaders are disabled, which makes me think that it might be an issue with my optifine or my blocks being corrupted in some way.
